name: 38133 · Bartlett, TN
findings: ZIP 38133 (Bartlett) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38133 (Bartlett) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 38133 (Bartlett) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
